name: forms-responder
description: Careful browser form completion and source-review workflows that never submit.

interface.shortDescription: Careful browser form answers that never submit
interface.longDescription: Carefully completes and audits browser forms, LMS pages, surveys, and source-based questions. Reviews required videos and readings, verifies every answer, and always leaves final submission to the user.
defaultPrompt: Complete this browser form carefully and stop before submission.
Review this form's video or reading and answer from evidence.
Audit every answer on this form without submitting it.
